# Improving type safety



## Typed wrapper functions

Instead of directly `pupa` classes and methods to build scraper objects, `scrapers-metro` has type-safe alternative functions which wrap around the native `pupa` functions. 

So far the following have been implemented:

(all from `lametro/bills.py`, see [PR #77]
(https://github.com/Metro-Records/scrapers-lametro/pull/77))

| For                         | Instead of              | Use                        |
|-----------------------------|-------------------------|----------------------------|
| Bill                        | `Bill()`                | `build_bill()`             |
| Bill Action                 | a plain dict            | `build_bill_action()`      |
| Action.related_entity (org) | `.add_related_entity()` | `add_related_entity_org()` |


## Classes

The following classes help ensure type safety by passing data in the expected way where their use has been implemented.

- `OrganizationRef(name: str)`
  - Pass references to organizations in the correct format
  - Implemented in:
    - `build_bill()`
    - `build_bill_action()`
    - `add_related_entity_org()`
